create_pose_from_vector: create a Pose object from a 6-element vector with xyz and rpy values
convert_pose_to_vector: convert a Pose object to a 6-element vector using the as_vec method
create_inertia_matrix: create an Inertia object and convert it to a 3x3 matrix using to_matrix
create_link_with_inertial: create a Link object with name, pose, and Inertial properties for SDF parsing
create_model_with_links: create a Model object with lists of links, joints, and plugins for SDF
